message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.**  
Atlanta’s noise‑enforcement process is handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department (APD)** and the **City Hall** (via the 311 system). Below are the main ways to report a noise issue:

| Method | How to Use It | Contact Info |
|--------|---------------|--------------|
| **Call 311** | Dial 311 from any phone (or 404‑656‑3111 if calling from within Atlanta). The dispatcher will route your call to the appropriate department. | 404‑656‑3111 |
| **Online Form** | Visit the City of Atlanta 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> → “Report a Problem” → select “Noise Complaint.” Fill out the required fields and submit. | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| **Email** | Send a detailed description of the noise problem to **noise@atlantaga.gov**. Include location, time, and any evidence (photos, audio clips). | noise@atlantaga.gov |
| **In‑person** | Go to City Hall (55 Martin Luther King Jr. Drive, Atlanta, GA 30303) and speak with the Noise Enforcement Unit or the City Clerk’s office. | City Hall, 55 MLK Jr. Drive |

### What the City of Atlanta’s Noise Ordinance Covers
- **Prohibited times:** Generally, loud or disruptive noise is prohibited after 10 p.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. on weekends.  
- **Types of noise:** Includes music, construction, barking dogs, loud parties, etc.  
- **Penalties:** Violations can result in fines, citations, or other enforcement actions.

**Reference:** Georgia Code Title 43, Chapter 5, Section 5‑5 (Noise Ordinance) – see the full text here: <https://law.justia.com/codes/georgia/2022/title-43/chapter-5/section-5-5/>

### Quick Steps to File a Complaint
1. **Gather details** – exact location, time, duration, and any evidence.  
2. **Choose a reporting method** – call 311, use the online form, email, or visit City Hall.  
3. **Submit the complaint** – provide all requested information.  
4. **Follow up** – you’ll receive a reference number; keep it for any future communication.

If the noise is an emergency (e.g., a fire alarm, ongoing violent activity), call **911** immediately. For non‑emergent issues, the 311 system or the Noise Enforcement Unit is the correct channel.

Feel free to let me know if you need help drafting an email or filling out the online form!
